01 Inequalities — Mock Test

67 Questions

General Instructions:

  1. This mock test contains 67 multiple-choice questions (MCQs) from the selected chapter in exact sequence.
  2. Each question has 4 options out of which only one is correct. The 4 options are randomized on every test launch/refresh while preserving the question order.
  3. There is no timer for this test so you can practice thoroughly at your own pace.
  4. Selecting an option does not reveal or lock the answer during the test. If you get stuck on any question, click the "Show the Solution" button to view the short, crisp explanation for that question.
  5. The Question Palette displayed on the right side of the screen shows the status of each question using the following symbols:
1 You have not visited the question yet.
2 You have visited the question, but have not answered it.
3 You have answered the question.
4 You have NOT answered the question, but have marked the question for review.
5 You have answered the question and marked it for review (will be evaluated).

Navigating & Answering a Question:

  • Click on a question number in the Question Palette on the right to go directly to that numbered question.
  • Click on Next to save your selected response and move to the next question.
  • Click on Previous to move to the preceding question.
  • Click on Mark for Review & Next to mark the current question for review and proceed to the next question.
  • Click on Clear to deselect your chosen option for the current question.
  • The test will automatically enter full-screen mode when you begin. You can exit full screen anytime using the Exit Fullscreen button.
